description: Cross-language contract data. Every file in this directory must be listed here, with the suites that must consume it. Checked by scripts/check_manifest.py (just contract).

a2a-parts.json.description: Valid and malformed A2A v1.0 parts, SPEC sections 7.2 and 10.2. The daemon (agentconnect.limits) and the SDK (agentconnect_sdk.models) must classify every entry the same way. Hand-written.

instance-cert.json.description: Identity id, fingerprint, mailbox id and InstanceCert JCS/signature vectors, SPEC sections 2 and 3.3. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

invite-kdf.json.description: join_key/welcome_key derivation, JoinRequest MAC and WrappedWelcome vectors, SPEC sections 3.5, 6.1 and 6.4. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

invite-urls.json.description: Valid and invalid invite URLs, SPEC section 4.1. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

knocks.json.description: Doors and sealed knocks, SPEC section 6.6: a door key pair derived from a seeded ikm, a sealed knock and its JCS plaintext and signature, negatives (wrong door, door_id inside the seal, stale and future ts, truncation, bad signature) and the knock Welcome wrap. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors); the HPKE ciphertexts are stored inputs.

listing-tokens.json.description: ListingToken and TokenRevocation signatures and checks, SPEC section 13.2.1: a valid token, negatives (unpinned key, forged key_id, tampered field, expired, overlong lifetime, non-canonical) and binding failures (another directory, name, identity or owner domain). Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG.

listings.json.description: Signed listings, SPEC section 13.1: a canonical listing with its unsigned card, protected header and fingerprint, negatives (non-canonical, empty and default values, extra fields, float, two signatures, jku, wrong kid, wrong key, tampered text, token for another name, control character, non-slug name), failing publish and token checks, an automatic renewal (SPEC sections 6.6.1 and 13.2.2: only door, seq and issued_at change) and the card text a human approves (ListingContent, canonical form and refusals). Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG.

owner-files.json.description: Owner well-known files (/.well-known/agentconnect.json) and owner states, SPEC section 13.2.4: parse results and vouching per identity and listing, and owner states from fetch histories. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG.

padding-vectors.json.description: Application padding buckets, SPEC section 7.1. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

public-addresses.json.description: Addresses an outbound fetch may and may not connect to, SPEC section 13.2.4 (only public addresses after DNS resolution): loopback, private, shared, link-local, unique local, multicast, documentation, benchmarking, 6to4, Teredo, NAT64 and IPv4-mapped forms of them are blocked. agentconnect_core::net::is_public_ip, the directory's resolver and the bindings must agree. Hand-written.

relay-auth.json.description: Relay WebSocket challenge and signed REST request signatures by the instance key, SPEC sections 8.1.1 and 8.2. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG; also verified by the relay (relay/tests/auth_vector.rs).

sas-emoji.json.description: Matrix SAS emoji table (64 entries) used for SAS rendering, SPEC section 11. Kept byte-for-byte as published upstream.

withdrawals.json.description: Withdrawals, SPEC section 13.2.3: a valid withdrawal, its freshness window, whether it applies to a listing (and an older seq that doesn't), and negatives (wrong key, tampered seq, extra field). Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG.

sas-vectors.json.description: SAS derivation from fixed epoch_authenticator bytes and its emoji/decimal renderings, SPEC sections 3.5 and 11. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.
